summary.text: Tina Davis is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 141 who has served since December 1, 2010 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a small business owner and former Bristol Township Council member.

paragraphs.text: Tina Davis earned a B.A. in computer science from La Salle University.
Her professional experience includes working as a real estate agent, owning a small business in the trucking industry, and serving as a Bristol Township Council member.
For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists Davis's committee assignment as the Rules Committee.
